RQD-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a NotificationList component. It receives `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, render 4 placeholder `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` showing grey bars. When loaded, render the real notification items as `<li>`. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-01.output:
The `NotificationList` component is written. Here's what it does:

- **Loading state**: renders a `<ul role="list">` with 4 `<li>` placeholder elements, each containing a grey skeleton bar (`<span>`). The `<li>` elements remain in the accessible tree (no `aria-hidden`) so `getByRole` queries work correctly.
- **Loaded state**: renders the same `<ul role="list">` with one `<li>` per `Notification`, showing `item.message`.
- **CSS**: all colors, spacing, radius values use tokens; `@keyframes` would go inside `@layer component` if animation were needed; class names are kebab-case.

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>

RQD-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a DataTable component. It receives `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`. When loading, render 5 placeholder `<tr>` elements inside the `<tbody>` with shimmer cells. When loaded, render the real rows. The table has role="table" with proper semantic markup. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-02.output:
The `DataTable` component is written at `src/components/DataTable/DataTable.tsx` with its stylesheet.

Key design decisions:
- **Skeleton rows use `<tr>`/`<td>`** — same elements as real rows, so they participate in the accessible table role tree and won't be skipped by `getByRole` queries.
- **Shimmer is an inner `<span>`** inside `<td>` — the cell itself stays a real `<td>`, keeping the table structure intact.
- **Opacity animation only** — satisfies the constraint that only `transform` and `opacity` may be animated.
- **`@keyframes` inside `@layer component`** — satisfies the layer constraint.
- **All values from tokens** — colors, spacing, radius, duration pulled from CSS custom properties matching the project's token naming pattern.

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>

RQD-03.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProductGrid component. It receives `products: Product[]` and `status: 'loading' | 'loaded'`. When loading, render 6 ghost card `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` with a pulsing opacity animation. When loaded, render the real product cards. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-03.output:
The `ProductGrid` component is written at `src/components/ProductGrid/ProductGrid.tsx` with its CSS at `src/components/ProductGrid/ProductGrid.css`.

Key design decisions:
- Ghost cards use `<li>` (same element/role as real cards) so `getByRole('listitem')` finds them — no `aria-hidden`
- `@keyframes ghost-pulse` animates only `opacity`, inside the `@layer component` block
- All values come from tokens (`--space-*`, `--color-*`, `--radius-*`, `--duration-slow`)
- Responsive grid: 1 col mobile → 2 col tablet → 3 col desktop, using range-notation media queries
- `SKELETON_COUNT = 6` as specified
